query:
SELECT
                requested.id AS "id!",
                requested.merged_into AS "merged_into?",
                COALESCE(c.custom_name, dd.name) AS "name?",
                primary_domain.domain AS "primary_domain?",
                c.last_interaction AS "updated_at!"
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    ids.id,
                    (
                        SELECT a.company_id
                        FROM crm_company_aliases a
                        WHERE a.retired_id = ids.id
                    ) AS merged_into
                FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest($2::uuid[]) AS ids (id)) ids
                OFFSET 0
            ) requested
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT id, team_id, custom_name, hidden, last_interaction
                FROM crm_companies
                WHERE id = COALESCE(requested.merged_into, requested.id)
                OFFSET 0
            ) c
            JOIN team_user tu
                ON tu.team_id = c.team_id
               AND tu.user_id = $1
               AND (tu.crm_access OR tu.team_role <> 'member')
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT d.domain
                FROM crm_domains d
                WHERE d.company_id = c.id
                ORDER BY d.created_at, d.id
                LIMIT 1
            ) primary_domain ON TRUE
            LEFT JOIN crm_domain_directory dd
                ON LOWER(dd.domain) = LOWER(primary_domain.domain)
            WHERE NOT c.hidden OR tu.team_role <> 'member'
